researchPlan.objective: Identify and extract active frontend engineering job openings at software companies located in India.
researchPlan.title: Active Frontend Engineering Roles in India

outputFields.name: company_name
outputFields.description: The name of the hiring software company
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for company branding or header information

outputFields.name: job_title
outputFields.description: The specific title of the frontend role
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for H1 tags or job title headers

outputFields.name: location
outputFields.description: The city or remote status of the position
outputFields.validationHint: Must be within India or specified as Remote
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for location metadata or city tags

outputFields.name: application_link
outputFields.description: Direct URL to the job application page
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid, reachable URL
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for 'Apply' or 'Submit' button href attributes

outputFields.name: source
outputFields.description: The platform where the job was found
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a known job board or company career site
outputFields.extractionHint: Identify the domain name of the source

researchPlan.sourceStrategy: Prioritize major job boards and direct company career pages to ensure high-quality, active listings.

validationRules.rule: Must be a valid URL and return a 200 OK status
Must be located in India or explicitly state Remote
